notes.title: Ver. 1.5.0 Update notice
notes.content:
Thank you for playing FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS.
This is a message from the management team.

We'd like to introduce the content of the Ver. 1.5.0 update.


Update Details
New Playable Character
Yuffie has been added as a playable character.

FINAL FANTASY VII New Chapter
FINAL FANTASY VII CHAPTER 5: The Wide, Wide World has been released.
*You must meet the unlock conditions to play this event.

New dungeon added to Criterion Dungeons/Crisis Dungeons
Mythril Mine has been added to Criterion Dungeons and Crisis Dungeons, and Fort Tamblin: Very Hard has been added to Crisis Dungeons.
*You must meet the unlock conditions to play this event.

Event and New Chapter Release Campaign On Now
The event Critical Threat Reawakened: Sephiroth - The Arrival and the New Chapter Release Campaign are on now.
Please check the corresponding notices for more information.

Other
- New app icon
- Minor quality of life improvements

Please Note:
- The event period and content are subject to change without notice.
- It may take some time for the new version of the app to be reflected in the store.
- Co-op content matching can not be conducted with players who have different versions of the app.
- If you have suspended dungeon data, the suspended will be discarded when the update is implemented.

Thank you for your continued support of FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS.

notes.title: Ver. 1.3.30 Update notice
notes.content:
Thank you for playing FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS.
This is a message from the management team.

We'd like to introduce the content of the Ver. 1.3.30 update.
The update is scheduled to release Dec. 14 6:00 PM PST.

Update Details

Summon Bahamut Arrives
Bahamut will be added to the Summon Quests.
Progress through Pact Missions to form a Pact with Bahamut.

CRISIS CORE -FINAL FANTASY VII- New Chapter Release
CRISIS CORE -FINAL FANTASY VII- CHAPTER 2 A SOLDIER's Honor will be released.
*This content will be unlocked by completing CRISIS CORE -FINAL FANTASY VII- CHAPTER 1 The Missing SOLDIER.

New Criterion Dungeon
Abandoned Factory will be added to Criterion Dungeons.

New Crisis Dungeon
Abandoned Factory and Sunsin Cave will be added to Crisis Dungeons.
*Sunsin Cave: Very Hard will be available until Jan. 11 2024, 5:59 PM PST.
*Crisis Dungeons are unlocked by clearing the Solo Content Battle Tower: Sealed Tower of Cetra Midgar Falls B10.

Character Maximum Level Increased
The Character Maximum Level will be increased to Lv. 65.
Along with the uncapping of characters' levels, the Character Stream will also be further unlocked.

100 Days Since Release Campaign
To commemorate 100 days since release, draw up to 150 times total for free over the campaign and get up to Blue Crystal x3,000.

Other
- Minor quality of life improvements.


Please Note:
- The event period and content are subject to change without notice.
- It may take some time for the new version of the app to be reflected in the store.
- Additional downloads will occur once opening the application after the update. As this will require more data consumption than usual, we recommend updating in a Wi-Fi environment.


Thank you for your continued support of FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS.

notes.title: Data Link Function Issue Notice
notes.content:
Thank you for playing FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS.
This is a message from the management team.

We are currently experiencing an issue with the Steam version of the game in which dialogues are not displayed during Link Data and payment processes.

The cause of this issue is currently under investigation, but we have found that it occurs more frequently when the Steam overlay setting is turned off. 
Therefore, when performing operations like Link Data that open a dialogue, please go to Library > Manage > Properties > General and turn on Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game.
*Please restart Steam after changing these settings.
*If you cannot select Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game, please check Steam Settings > In Game > Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game.

If the above does not resolve the issue, please contact us from Inquiries in the FFVII EC menu.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
Thank you for your continued support of FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS.

notes.title: New players get luxurious gifts!
notes.content:
Start FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS to get luxurious gifts!

New players will recieve the below gifts, so make sure to add FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS to your wishlist!
- Blue Crystal x3,000
- 5★ Wpn. Guaranteed Draw Ticket x1
- Draw Ticket x30
- Gear Voucher x1
- Jumpstart Item Set x2
- 5★ Zweihander x1
- 5★ Apology in Hell x1
There was a mismatch between the images and the text regarding the gifts.
As the images displayed the correct information, we have fixed the text to reflect this.

*These gifts will be redeemable from the Gift Box in-game.
*The contents are the same as the pre-registration rewards distributed at the time of the iOS/Android version release.
*The same rewards will also be given out to new players of the iOS/Android version of the game.
*Those who have already received the pre-registration rewards for the iOS/Android version will not be eligible for these rewards.
